title: assessment-monitoring
description: Prove assessment persistence, uncertainty, feedback and frozen exports through the production gateway. Seed only an isolated validation home first; rerun after restarting it.

gateway-proof.intent: Assessment history preserves terminal uncertainty and saved feedback.

browser-proof.intent: Assessment feedback persists the revision entered through the real detail view.

pagination-proof.intent: Paginated assessment edits preserve their draft identity.

restart-proof.intent: Assessment restart retains saved feedback and interrupted attempts.

screenshot.intent: Capture the actual isolated assessment UI after real gateway actions.
